edits.current: THE PRINCIPAL PAYROLL CASILLA ON THE WITHHOLDING SIDE. Sum of the income-tax withholding at source actually practised on work income paid to RESIDENT natural persons in the calendar month, across EVERY pay group and EVERY payroll run of the entity in that month - regular, weekly or exceptional-advance, termination and settlement runs alike - in whole pesos, then rounded once to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577). Source: wage type 2552 'Income Tax (employee)' (Deductions), plus wage type 21330 'Personal Income Tax Withholding (Theoretical)' where it carries the withholding actually deducted from the employee's pay (the case in which the WT 2552 line is a zero-value Non Cash item). The amount is the withholding actually deducted from the employee's pay, computed with the employee's AFC and voluntary-pension contributions (ET arts. 126-1 and 126-4) taken into account; never the figure computed without those contributions. Contingent withholding (ET arts. 126-1 / 126-4) - the difference between the withholding computed without and with those contributions - is practised by the AFC or voluntary-pension fund when the savings are withdrawn before the permanence requirement is met; it is not practised by the employer and does not enter this return, and the wage types that carry a theoretical or hypothetical amount never deducted - 21114 'Theoretical income Tax-5011', 21619 'Theoretical Income Tax - Ajuste - 5035' and 25834 'Hypothetical Witholding Tax  - IC Foreign Country' - are out of scope: a theoretical or hypothetical amount is not withholding actually practised. WT 2552 withholding deducted in advance runs (WT 61100 'Weekly advance', WT 62838 'Exceptional Advance') and in termination or settlement runs (WT 62116, 62110, 62203, 62115) enters in the month it is practised, whatever the run. Withholding deducted on WT 21129 (Terminations), 25832 (Stock awards vesting) and 25833 (IC Local Country) enters in the month it is practised. Whether a wage type carries withholding actually practised, and therefore feeds casilla 93, follows from the withholding classification of each wage type, which comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC) attribute; the wage types named here are the ones so classified. Withholding on the pension income the employer pays itself (WT 21140 'Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees- 6799', WT 21155 'Income Tax Pensioner') is not reported here: it goes to casilla 94, with its base in casilla 78. Withholding at the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on a NON-RESIDENT foreign natural person is not reported here: it is supplied as sheet-2 rows (casillas 141-146) in the 'Pagos al exterior' section, with the sheet-2 payment concept and country, on the nominal (gross) value and with no depuration, and rolls into casillas 111 / 112; the employee's tax-residence flag, not the withholding rate or the tax-procedure code, decides the section. Accumulate by the payroll engine's run key (pay group and run), not by a report-level identifier. Casilla 93 plus casilla 94 must reconcile to the sum of RetencionFuente (NIE177) across every electronic payroll document for the same month, after the nearest-1,000 rounding. It is one of the forty-two casillas summed into casilla 130. TIMING: the withholding is practised, and therefore declared, in the month of the payment or of the credit to the employee's account, whichever comes first, never by the pay period the run settles - a run whose period ends in one month and that is paid in the next is declared in the month of payment, and a run paid on the last day of a month belongs to that month (ET art. 383: withholding on the payments made; ET art. 27: the income of a natural person is realised when it is received; instruction guide of Res. DIAN 000031/2024: the return declares the withholding practised in the month). Accumulate the runs by their payment date, not by their period.

edits.current: Accumulate the withholding at source actually withheld on work income from resident natural persons in the month: wage type 2552 'Income Tax (employee)', plus the withholding deducted on 21129 (terminations), 25832 (stock-award vesting) and 25833 (IC local) in the month it is practised, across every pay group and run. Exclude the contingent withholding of ET arts. 126-1 / 126-4 - the withholding computed without the AFC and voluntary-pension contributions less the withholding computed with them - which is practised by the fund on an early withdrawal and never by the employer, and exclude the theoretical and hypothetical wage types 21114, 21619 and 25834, which carry no withholding actually practised (wage type 21330 is included only where it carries the withholding actually deducted). Withholding on the pensions the employer pays itself (21140, 21155) goes to casilla 94, not here. Each employee's withholding is itself already approximated to the nearest 1,000 under ET art. 868; accumulate those approximated figures and then apply the art. 577 nearest-1,000 rounding to the total. Reconcile casilla 93 plus casilla 94 to the sum of RetencionFuente (NIE177) across every electronic payroll document for the same month BEFORE filing. Select the runs by their payment date - payment or credit to account, whichever comes first - not by the pay period they settle (ET art. 383; ET art. 27; instruction guide of Res. DIAN 000031/2024).
